provenance.abstention_policy: Not treated as correct negatives. Included as missed positives in all-population recall; excluded from conditional accuracy.
provenance.category_policy: Families use the explicit many-to-one crosswalk in evaluation.py; original-label table reports detection, not invented category-specific precision.
provenance.confidence_scope: H1 is development data; target transfer accuracy is not established.
provenance.whole_row_event: Correct binary flag AND exact expected cents. Billed cents/identity validated separately; free-text category correctness is reported by family, not included in this event.
